# React Native Mobile Development Project

This is a React Native project set up for cross-platform mobile development with Expo CLI.

## Project Guidelines

- Focus on mobile-first development for iOS and Android
- Use Expo SDK for cross-platform compatibility
- Ensure all dependencies work on mobile devices
- Test on both physical devices and simulators
- Follow React Native best practices for performance
- Use TypeScript for type safety

## Development Notes

- All components should be mobile-optimized
- Consider screen sizes and mobile UI/UX patterns
- Handle platform-specific code when necessary
- Optimize for mobile performance and battery usage
